fnol_text: My name is Priya Mbeki and I live at 601 Alder Road, Ashland, OR 97592. You can reach me on (555) 522-2133 or priya.mbeki@example.com. I was stopped at lights on 6 December 2025 when the car behind, driven by Kofi Mensah, went into the back of mine. Rear bumper and boot are badly damaged. Policy MT-2024-00007. adjuster_notes.text: Called Ms Mbeki on (555) 522-2133 to acknowledge the claim. Priya confirmed the loss date as 6 December 2025.
